name: PMKM/Pomogi Mne Kupit' Moloko!
source:
A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一则短篇故事，讲述日常中的小事也可能成为怎样的挑战。帮助女孩买牛奶，成为第一个没有让她失望的人。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392820/]Steam[/url]]
